acceptanceRule: Stable owner-visible publication requires explicit owner PASS for every required screen group. Acceptance records the exact reviewed APK artifact and binds to deterministic visual and release-input digests. A later change to app code/media, dependency lock, branding recipe, pinned toolchain contract or release workflow invalidates publication until the owner reviews a newly validated APK. APK SHA remains evidence of the reviewed artifact; reproducibility is enforced through the locked release inputs rather than assuming two independent Android builds are byte-identical.
